title: Polynomial Regret Concentration of UCB for Non-Deterministic State Transitions
summary: This paper extends the theoretical framework of Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to stochastic domains by deriving polynomial regret concentration bounds for the Upper Confidence Bound algorithm in multi-armed bandit problems with non-deterministic state transitions. The authors prove that these bounds apply to non-deterministic environments with fixed transition probabilities, broadening MCTS applicability to real-world decision-making problems such as autonomous systems and financial decision-making where probabilistic outcomes are prevalent.
notes:
